name: Fundamentals of Medical Genomics
description: History of genomics, overview of human genome structure and variation, introduction to precision medicine, GWAS to PheWAS, genomic technologies in clinical practice (NGS, liquid biopsy, CRISPR editing in therapeutics), variant classification, functional annotation of genetic variants, polygenic risk scores and disease prediction, genomics of rare and inherited diseases, cancer genomics, ethical, legal, and social implications for handling and sharing genomic data, applications of genomic medicine.
